stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same moment from two towns 140 km apart and drive towards each other at 60 km/h and 30 km/h. After how many hours do they meet? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Moving towards each other, the gap shrinks at the sum of the speeds: $60 + 30 = 90$ km/h. Time $= \dfrac{140}{90} = 1.5556$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: Closing speed is what matters, not either speed alone — this is the whole idea of relative speed.
